command.description: Check the last turn for a gap in your thinking now and show a question card
card.title: 🔍 {kind} check
card.free.label: Answer in your own words
check.off: The question card is off here. To turn it on, say "turn on the question card" or run /hack-user-skills-criteria-gap:criteria-init.
check.pending: A question is already waiting above the prompt.
check.no_turn: There is no turn to check yet.
check.asked: A question is up above the prompt.
check.none: Found no gap worth asking about in the last turn.
check.failed: The check could not run this time. Try again later.
